newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen spurns Service Corp offer.
newsitem.headline: Loewen spurns Service Corp offer.

text.p: Loewen Group Inc chairman and chief executive officer Raymond Loewen said in a released statement that the funeral company's board of directors had unanimously rejected a proposed takeover offer from Service Corp Inc.

"In rejecting the proposal, the board considered many factors and unanimously concluded that the best way to maximize value for our shareholders is through the continued implementation of the company's long-term business plan as an independent company," Loewen said.
Loewen said that the board believes the company has a bright future for continued growth, is the preferred acquiror in the industry and is not surprised that Service Corp is trying to buy it.

Service Corp last week made an unsolicited offer to buy Loewen in a stock transaction valued at US$2.8 billion. The offer also calls for the assumption of US$1.3 billion of Loewen debt. The proposed union would combine the two largest operators of funeral homes and cemeteries in North America.
